text:
kevin: Heads up — ops wants to unpin runtime on prod for the new kernel improvements. Target window: today 22:00 UTC. Canaries in us-west & eu-central.
alina: what safe guards do we need? last time longseq customers saw regressions.
sam: Suggest phased regional unpin: us-west -> eu-central -> ap-southeast. 30m between waves. Keep old runtime as fallback label.
miguel: Is SDK compatibility locked? We still have ~10% clients on sdk 2.4.x. Need to ensure negotiation fallback works.
charlie: From infra: we can route traffic to pinned pool if model/runtime fails, but we need the deploybot flag enabled for quick rollback.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Planned action: UNPIN runtime v3.1.4 -> allow runtime v3.2.0. Canary groups: canary-1(us-west), canary-2(eu-central). Auto-fallback: true. Rollback window: 45m after each wave. To execute: `/deploy run unpin-runtime --target runtime:3.2.0 --waves 3 --wave-delay 30m --rollback-window 45m`
kevin: QA runbook is below. Anyone object to that schedule?
qa-bot: [qa-bot] Canary health quick checks: token throughput, latency p99, kv-cache hitrate, mem growth. Test suite: `canary_smoke.sh`. Current last run: PASS (2026-03-20).
alina: If any customer-facing error rate (5xx) increases by >1% we pause and rollback. Also monitor embedding drift for relevant models.
sam: Add an additional check: model output regressed on the stability eval set (prompt set S-regen). If regression > 2% abort.
miguel: For SDK: we'll publish a compatibility note and advise `sdk>=2.5.0` but runtime will accept older clients, with a slower path. Add an opt-in header `X-RDWD-Compat: legacy` for tracing.
charlie: Ops will prepare pinned fallback pool and manual route commands. Runbook snippet:
```
# If canary fails
/deploy rollback-runtime --target runtime:3.1.4
/route set routing policy --fallback-pool pinned-runtime-3.1.4
/alerts notify "runtime-unpin-failed" --severity high
```
kevin: timeline: canary-1 start 22:00, observe 22:30, canary-2 22:45, observe 23:15, global 23:30. This keeps 30m gaps.
alina: blackout windows note — do not run during finance batch (23:00-23:20 UTC) for a set of customers. Shift eu-central observe window earlier if needed.
sam: I'll draft the release note blurb and ops checklist. Will include rollback commands and example monitoring queries.
miguel: I'll prepare the SDK advisory and create a short migration guide snippet.
charlie: I'll be on-call for the entire window, have the pinned pool hot.
kevin: ok green from me if deploy-bot can expose a dry-run first and qa-bot passes smokes.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Dry-run completed: no blocking checks. Canary jobs scheduled. Executing at 22:00 UTC.
qa-bot: [qa-bot] Canary smoke schedule: canary-1 (22:00-22:30), canary-2 (22:45-23:15). Will post results in thread.
alina: thanks — ping @kevin/@charlie if anything spikes. :eyes:
kevin: thanks all. I'll merge the unpin PR and update the changelog entries.
sam: Added note to release notes draft: "Runtime 3.2.0: kernel optimizations, batching improvements, compatibility shim for sdk<2.5.0; phased unpin recommended."
charlie: canary-1 smoke reports in 22:18 — posting results shortly.
qa-bot: [qa-bot] canary-1 results: p50/p95/p99 healthy, 5xx delta +0.1%, mem stable. PASS.
kevin: proceed to canary-2.
qa-bot: [qa-bot] canary-2 results: p99 small increase +0.4%, some latency tailing for seq>8k. FAIL threshold for longseq regressed 2.7% on S-regen.
alina: abort global unpin. Rollback canary-2, escalate to infra and ops for triage.
charlie: initiating rollback for canary-2 now. Running: `/deploy rollback-runtime --target runtime:3.1.4 --group canary-2`
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Rollback executed for canary-2. Notifying routing change.
miguel: gather kernel logs and kv-cache metrics for failed group. I'll investigate quantization path differences.
sam: I'll pause release note publish and mark the unpin as blocked pending root cause.
kevin: good catch. We'll reconvene after triage. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
